==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I see three giant doors across the street. The doors are blocking my view. I am amazed and confused.

I leave to tell others about the doors. When I return the doors are gone. They are replaced by three giant people.

A woman tells me that what I saw was her unborn brother. She hands me a doll that represents her brother. I remember that I too have a sibling that was never born.
